bobsweep - maxim all-in-one robot vacuum.name: bObsweep - Maxim All-in-One Robot Vacuum & Mop, 22000 Pa Suction, Odor-Filter AutoWash/Dry/Empty Dock, w EdgeReach - Titanium Black
bobsweep - maxim all-in-one robot vacuum.description: Congratulate yourself on a new level of lazy. Maxim is the champion of clean tech, built to give you a truly hands-off floor-care lifestyle: the Autonomous Clean Experience (ACE). Press GO, walk away, and let Maxim handle the rest. Maxim doesn’t just “clean” — he dominates mess. With a ferocious 22,000 Pa of suction power and tangle-resistant brushes, he inhales dust, crumbs, and pet hair without stealing a single minute of your day. His EdgeReach side brush sweeps debris out of baseboards and corners, while the extendable mop arm presses in along edges and around furniture legs to wipe where most bots leave a dirty outline. Translation: fewer missed crumbs, fewer wall-hugging dust lines, and noticeably cleaner edges in every room. And here’s the best part: Maxim is the rare smart device you can actually trust. Maxim keeps your home’s visuals where they belong — on the robot. No cloud. No servers. No “upload to improve your experience.” With 100% on-board, off-cloud vision processing and real-time navigation engineered in the U.S. and Canada, Maxim cleans with intelligence you can trust. He never sends images anywhere, period. His brain is just as serious as his muscle. Maxim’s navigation and software are engineered entirely in the U.S. and Canada, combining LiDAR with our QSLAM® technology and real-time, 100% on-board processing. No “training sessions.” No wandering around. Maxim identifies rooms quickly, builds an immediate, detailed, color-coded map in the app, and lets you call the shots. Draw NoSweep zones, custom clean areas, schedules, and room-by-room routines — and Maxim follows like a pro. And when vacuuming isn’t enough, Maxim brings the shine. Dual-scrub mopping pads rotate in counter-motion to scrub hard floors, while intelligently avoiding carpets using FloorSense technology. Paw prints, kitchen streaks, and “mystery marks” don’t get a chance — Maxim deletes them. Big home? Maxim can freshen up as many times as needed, recharge, and resume to finish the mission. And when Maxim needs to freshen up, the extra-large charging station takes over and delivers on the promise of all-in-one: debris self-empties into an odor-blocking, activated-carbon-lined bag; mop pads get washed and hot-air dried; and the station keeps itself fresh — so you’re not dealing with dirty pads or swampy smells.
